author: bardic-inspiration
name: Rockmite Swarm
summary: A seething mass of pebble-sized beetles that chews the cave floor to rubble around whatever it's eating.
description: Rockmites eat stone, slowly, and flesh, quickly. Where a swarm has fed, the floor is pitted and loose for yards around, and old tunnels sag where generations of them have hollowed the walls. The clicking of their jaws carries a long way, and wise travelers turn around when they hear it.

traits.name: Crumbling Ground
traits.text: The ground in the swarm's space and within 5 feet of it is {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain} for creatures other than the swarm.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny beetle. The swarm can't regain {ref:glossary/hit-points} or gain {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points}.

actions.name: Bites
actions.onHit: The attack deals half damage if the swarm is {ref:glossary/bloodied}.
